name: Gradient-Isosurface Texture Packing
definition: A data layout strategy where gradients are stored in the RGB components of a 3D volume texture, and the original isovalue is stored in the Alpha component. This allows using a single texture for both data and shading.
summary: Gradient-Isosurface Texture Packing stores pre-computed gradients in RGB and isovalue in Alpha within a single 3D texture, enabling hardware-interpolated shading without runtime gradient calculation.
